reason: Twenty-two thousand is two months of what the whole family earns, and ₹2,000 every month for a year is more than we can promise when the harvest money is uncertain. The women already wash by hand and it costs us nothing, so this is not where our money goes first.
objection: Will a cold wash really get the mud and sweat out of farm clothes, or will they still have to scrub them by hand after paying all that money?
would_change_my_mind: If the dealer let me pay small amounts after harvest instead of a fixed EMI every month, and showed me it cleaning our muddy work clothes in front of me.
